notes: v264 — NAV-LANE-INSET-EMPTY (owner, Mon Oct 26, 2026 08:23 MDT, drive test: the pre-turn card "still isn't give me any useable information.... Any lanes or anything else"). DIAGNOSIS (live probes against his own server + OpenStreetMap itself): (1) The native Valhalla response carries NO lane data at any level — four corridor routes probed exactly as the app asks, every maneuver key enumerated — and his Valhalla 3.9.1 has no config that adds lanes to the native format (valhalla-config.json checked). But the SAME server, asked for the SAME route with format:'osrm', returns real per-lane indications with the server's own valid flags (79 laned intersections across the Deerfoot / Stoney / 16 Ave / Glenmore / Peigan probe routes). (2) The response DOES carry sign blocks (17 of 58 maneuvers probed: EXIT 258, 68, 88, 246-245, 234B, branch + toward) and maneuverPlan dropped the whole object, so the card could never show an exit number, the road taken, or where it points. (3) The Overpass lane fallback could not fire: pickTurnLanes read ONLY turn:lanes:forward, while direct OSM API reads of his junctions show Calgary tags plain turn:lanes on one-way carriageways (Deerfoot Tr NE: through|through|through;right|right; Barlow Tr SE the same pattern) and essentially never the :forward form — and both public Overpass endpoints answered 429 to a gentle sequential probe today. FIX: maneuverPlan keeps the sign (maneuverSign), sanitizeTruckPlan carries it through, and the inset paints a sign block under its header (road-sign-green EXIT chip + the road taken + 'toward …') on every pop whose maneuver carries sign data — the card never pops without usable information again. Lanes now come from his OWN server: the ADOPTED route request is replayed once in OSRM format (fetchServerLanes, off the critical path like the grade fetch), osrmLaneData reads the laned intersections and matchServerLanes pins them to maneuvers (<=75 m of the turn point); the pop-up prefers them and the server's valid flags decide which lanes burn (real fixture: exit 258 lights its two right lanes). The Overpass path stays as fallback, widened honestly: turn:lanes:forward read wherever it stands (the suffix IS the forward lanes), plain turn:lanes read on one-way ways, plain on a two-way way still refused, a contradicting lane count still distrusts the strip (Barlow's lanes=2 against 3 marked slots answers nothing). COVERAGE, measured not promised: 17 of 54 probed turn boundaries carry server lane data (all freeway-class — residential turns have no lane tagging anywhere, honest absence), signs cover 5 of 11 maneuvers on the site->home fixture (17 of 58 across the probes). No server change was needed or made. PRESERVED: v259/v260/v261/v262/v263 work untouched in behavior — chase pitch + lift, native-z18 tiles, vibrant palette, the no-U-turn layers, traffic, auto-start. Suites: new nav-lane-inset-v264 32/32 on REAL probe fixtures; v238 re-based to the widened orientation rule 35/35; v196 30/30; v135 restored to 95/95 (its stub answers the osrm replay benignly, like the Nominatim bystander); navigator-test 169/12 = its v263 baseline failure set + one new passing pin (exactly one lanes replay per adoption; routing ledgers count routing requests via isRoutingFetch); all other nav suites at baseline.
